DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.label: flesh cultivation bed
DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.description: A sprawling bed of interconnected cultivated flesh. Its base daily output is 50 twisted meat, with a base efficiency of 2.\n\nThe total capacity of stationed fleshbeasts of yours adds to its efficiency.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.label: hive neural relay
DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.description: A remote neural relay woven into the flesh hive network. It increases fleshbeast capacity by 3, plus 2 for each outpost upgrade.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostTypeDef.label: flesh cultivation outpost
DreamsOutposts.OutpostTypeDef.description: A remote flesh cultivation site. Its twisted meat output increases with the hive capacity cost of stationed player fleshbeasts.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostTypeDef.label: hive neural relay station
DreamsOutposts.OutpostTypeDef.description: A remote neural station linked to the colony's flesh hive network. Its core increases fleshbeast capacity, and can host dedicated expansion slots.
